meaning:
συν-ζεύγνυμι
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Eze.1:11, 23 (חָבַר) * ;]
to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Mat.19:6, Mrk.10:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”
What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
